entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: An artificial metal plane lit by four suns, home to leonin, vedalken, goblins, elves, trolls and nim.

entities.name: Glissa Sunseeker
entities.description: An elf who searches for the secret at the heart of Mirrodin and the truth about Memnarch.

entities.name: Ushanti
entities.description: A leonin seer who speaks of the wisdom of elders as a weapon.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: The leonin kha and destined leader of the leonin prides, whose throne is Taj-Nar.

entities.name: Janus
entities.description: Speaker of the synod, the vedalken governing body.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: A Neurok leader.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: An elder researcher among the vedalken.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Keeper of the Vault and warlord who commands countless nim from Ish Sah.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A goblin tinkerer.

entities.name: Gron
entities.description: A goblin whose mind reels with possibilities.

entities.name: Bosh, Iron Golem
entities.description: An iron golem who searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mirrodin's protector, a being who understands what the Knowledge Pool knows and who turned from silent guardian to merciless god.

entities.name: The Knowledge Pool
entities.description: A vedalken source of knowledge at Lumengrid, protected at any cost.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: Vedalken region of Mirrodin, site of the Knowledge Pool.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A dark, corrosive region of Mirrodin home to the nim and ruled by Geth.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: Wellspring of molten metal and temple of the goblin horde.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: Sanctum of the ancient trolls, keepers of the secret of Mirrodin's origin.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: Throne of Raksha Golden Cub.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: The forest of Mirrodin, home to the elves.

entities.name: The Radix
entities.description: A sacred elf site where the dead are laid and unnatural magic is erased.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Feline people of Mirrodin led by a kha.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Knowledge-seeking people of Lumengrid.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Mirrodin's mindless, ravenous undead.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Small metal creatures that observe everywhere, overlooked by the peoples of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Levelers
entities.description: Constructs that rip through Mirrodin once a century, obeying an unseen master.

events.summary: Glissa Sunseeker declares she will unlock the secret at the heart of Mirrodin.
events.quote: There's a secret at the heart of this world, and I will unlock it.

events.summary: Glissa says someone is defying the gods and shaping the planet, and she intends to stop it.
events.quote: Someone or something is defying the power of the gods and shaping this planet. I intend for it to stop.

events.summary: Glissa is amazed at the darkness of Mephidross.
events.quote: I would never have believed that on a world with four suns there could exist a place so dark.

events.summary: Leonin fight to keep their memories from being pulled into the necrogen mists.
events.quote: Mephidross filled with roars of fury and wails of despair as the leonin fought to keep their memories from being pulled into the mists.

events.summary: A leonin kha stuns a nim raider into kneeling.
events.quote: Stunned by the mere presence of the leonin kha, the nim raider quickly fell to its knees.

events.summary: A nim is consumed in sunfire, leaving only molten iron.
events.quote: Within seconds, the nim was consumed in blinding sunfire.

events.summary: Janus laments the murder of an idea.
events.quote: Murder of the living is tragic, but murder of the idea is unforgivable.

events.summary: Janus says the Knowledge Pool knows and Memnarch understands.
events.quote: The Knowledge Pool knows. Memnarch understands.

events.summary: Bruenna taunts a foe held in an inertia bubble.
events.quote: I wouldn't want you to hurt yourself.

events.summary: Geth speaks of conquest and pawns.
events.quote: In the game of conquest, who cares about the pawns if the king yet reigns?

events.summary: Slobad remarks on the luck of Krark's Thumb.
events.quote: I can think of *one* goblin it ain't so lucky for.

events.summary: Raksha Golden Cub praises the skyhunters who raise the alarm against levelers.
events.quote: They are the first to raise the alarm when the levelers attack, and the first to risk their lives to defend the pride.

events.summary: Bosh searches for the secrets of his past while Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch.
events.quote: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

events.summary: Ur-golem etchings tell of Memnarch's change from guardian to merciless god.
events.quote: The ur-golem runes tell of the transformation of Mirrodin's warden from silent guardian to merciless god.

relations.note: leonin kha, destined leader of the prides
relations.quote: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.
Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.
They end by cursing its protector, a being called Memnarch.
